description: This source file defines the TouchRotateActivity class for an Android application demonstrating OpenGL rendering. It includes an inner class TouchSurfaceView that handles touch and trackball events to rotate a 3D cube, and a nested CubeRenderer class implementing OpenGL rendering logic.

classes.name: TouchRotateActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating OpenGL ES usage with a touch-controlled rotating cube.

classes.name: TouchSurfaceView
classes.description: Custom GLSurfaceView subclass handling touch and trackball events for rotating the cube.

classes.name: CubeRenderer
classes.description: Renderer implementing OpenGL ES drawing logic for a spinning cube.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the custom GLSurfaceView as content.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume by calling GLSurfaceView's onResume.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause by calling GLSurfaceView's onPause.

methods.name: onTrackballEvent
methods.description: Handles trackball motion events for rotating the cube.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Processes touch events for rotating the cube.

methods.name: onCapturedPointerEvent
methods.description: Handles pointer capture release and update during touch interactions.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Releases pointer capture on key press to enable rotation controls.

methods.name: updateAngles
methods.description: Updates the cube's rotation angles based on user input.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Draws the current frame, applying rotations to the cube.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection matrix when the surface size changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL settings for rendering the cube.
